question: Who among the following recipients of Kalidas Samman is associated with Classical Dance?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sonal Mansingh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Sonal Mansingh** is a renowned Indian classical dancer and choreographer of Odissi dance style, and she is also proficient in Bharatanatyam and Kuchipudi.
 
• She has been honored with several prestigious awards including the **Padma Bhushan** in 1992 and the **Padma Vibhushan** in 2003 for her contributions to Indian classical dance.
 
• Sonal Mansingh has played a pivotal role in popularizing Indian classical dance forms both in India and internationally.
 
• She has been actively involved in various cultural and artistic initiatives and has also served as a nominated member of the Rajya Sabha, the upper house of India's Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kalidas Samman**

 
 
• The Kalidas Samman is a prestigious arts award presented annually by the government of Madhya Pradesh in India.
 
• It is named after the classical Sanskrit poet Kalidasa and is awarded for outstanding achievement in the fields of classical music, classical dance, theatre, and visual arts.
 
• The award includes a cash prize, a citation, and a plaque.
 
• Recipients of the Kalidas Samman are selected for their exceptional contribution to the preservation and promotion of Indian art and culture.
 
 
 
• **Jagdish Swaminathan**
 
 
• Jagdish Swaminathan was an influential Indian artist and writer known for his contributions to Indian modern art.
 
• He was one of the founding members of the Group 1890, an avant-garde group of artists in India.
 
 
 
• **Manna Dey**
 
 
• Manna Dey was a legendary Indian playback singer known for his work in Hindi, Bengali, and other Indian languages.
 
• He received numerous awards including the Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and the Dadasaheb Phalke Award.
 
 
 
• **Vilayat Khan**
 
 
• Vilayat Khan was a renowned Indian sitar maestro and is considered one of the greatest sitar players of all time.
 
• He was awarded the Padma Shri and Padma Bhushan but famously refused both honors.
